parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.tournament_id, m.division_id, m.match_no, m.stage, m.group_no, m.status, m.event_count, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, m.scorer_user_id, t.sport, d.points AS division_points, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', x.id, 'stage', x.stage, 'group_no', x.group_no, 'status', x.status, 'home_entry_id', x.home_entry_id,   'away_entry_id', x.away_entry_id, 'winner_entry_id', x.winner_entry_id, 'home_score', x.home_score, 'away_score', x.away_score,   'outcome', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.live, '$.outcome')), 'standing', JSON_EXTRACT(x.live, '$.standing')))  FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = m.division_id) AS division_matches, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'group_no', e.group_no)) FROM tournament_entries e  WHERE e.division_id = m.division_id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS division_teams, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, m.scorer_seen_at, NOW()) AS scorer_idle, sc.name AS scorer_name, viewer.id AS viewer_id, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_scorers sc WHERE sc.tournament_id = t.id AND sc.user_id = viewer.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_officials f JOIN tournament_officials_requests q ON q.tournament_id = f.tournament_id WHERE f.tournament_id = t.id AND f.user_id = viewer.id AND f.role = 'SCORER' AND q.status = 'CONFIRMED')) AS can_score, hm.name AS home_name, aw.name AS away_name FROM tournament_matches m JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = m.division_id JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN app_users sc ON sc.id = m.scorer_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries he ON he.id = m.home_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams hm ON hm.id = he.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries ae ON ae.id = m.away_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams aw ON aw.id = ae.team_id WHERE m.id = $2
